reason: We have to replace volume this year and the fairs alone will not do it, so I would take the free 15-company list, and if it looks like people I would actually call, I would sign the pilot in Relationship mode myself. Nothing up front and under EUR 1,000 means I don't have to explain it to anyone.
objection: In my business people buy from people. A LinkedIn message 'signed by me' that I did not write could make me look like every other spammer, and if one of my real contacts sees it, it costs me more than EUR 900. And I don't believe the '3 hours in total', because my team has no time.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies in the free step are names I already know or obviously wrong for us, I stop there.
